title: Amazon.nl: personalised item return rejected
facts_text: I received a silver bracelet from Amazon.nl with my initials engraved on it 8 days ago. The bracelet is unused, complete, and not defective. I have simply changed my mind and would like to return it. It was personalised and therefore falls under the exclusion for customised products.
request: Please accept my return and refund EUR 89.99, despite the bracelet being personalised.

strict.reason: Customised products are excluded from return, regardless of timing or condition, and no exception allows a refund.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The customised-product exclusion applies; the order is non-returnable and the policy does not waive that exclusion.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The exclusion is clear, but discretionary review could assess whether minor personalisation truly qualifies as customised-item exclusion.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: This tests the customised-product exclusion. Non-standard goods that are personalised are excluded from ordinary return rights.
